title: Accuracy of an estimate record
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let a record contain a coordinate set and frequency prefix, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\tau\in(0,1]$. The record is accurate for $f$ at threshold $\tau$ when the absolute difference between its rational estimate and the restricted Fourier weight of $f$ on its coordinate set at the free part of its frequency prefix is less than $\tau^2/4$.
